input_image_hash_verification.method: SHA-256 checked against receipt products, read-only, before viewing.

observable: C: lower-right contrast junction of the prominent dark upper-facade rectangular band, at right termination and lower sloping edge.
coordinate_convention: Integer native image pixel centers; x increases right and y down; native size 720x480.
bounds_convention: Inclusive subjective localization bounds from image legibility; not calibrated confidence intervals, not extrapolated positions.
independence: Did not read root C coordinates, earlier A/B coordinate arrays, fitted results, or geometry conclusions before freezing. This is a separate computational observer using shared derivatives, not an independent camera or a human/expert measurement.
